raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`NixlConnector` reads `kv_connector_extra_config.num_threads` but forwards it to NIXL only when UCX is the sole backend. With any non-UCX backend configured, the value is silently dropped. This PR forwards an explicitly set `num_threads` to every backend and leaves the default behavior unchanged.

## Claims

- An explicitly set `num_threads` now reaches every backend:
  - in the agent config (`nixl_agent_config(num_threads=...)`), where NIXL maps it to each backend's own parameter;
  - in the explicit `create_backend` loop used when `ucx_backend_params` is set.
- When `num_threads` is not set, behavior is unchanged: UCX alone keeps the UCX-tuned default of `4`, and non-UCX backends keep NIXL's defaults. No new default is introduced for any backend.
- `num_threads` is documented in `docs/features/nixl_connector_usage.md`.

## Validation

- Root cause traced in the source at `main` (see Details). NIXL already forwards `nixl_agent_config.num_threads` to its backends ([`nixl/_api.py`](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/nixl/blob/a2165b56/src/api/python/_api.py#L259-L266)), so the value is lost on the vLLM side.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass.
- `pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py -k "backend_params or num_threads"`:
  - with this PR: 11 passed
  - on `main` (same tests): 3 failed, 8 passed

    ```text
    FAILED tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py::test_ucx_backend_params[extra_config3-agent_backends3-created_backends3]
    FAILED tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py::test_nixl_num_threads[extra_config3-agent_backends3-8]
    FAILED tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py::test_nixl_num_threads[extra_config5-agent_backends5-2]
    ```

- Validated internally end to end in a 1P1D NixlConnector deployment with the LIBFABRIC backend: requests succeed with and without `num_threads`, and the configured value now reaches the LIBFABRIC backend (previously dropped).

## Details

**Root cause.** In `NixlBaseConnectorWorker.__init__`, `num_threads` is dropped in two places:
1. Agent config: the branch for non-UCX backends builds `nixl_agent_config(backends=..., capture_telemetry=True)` without `num_threads`.
2. Explicit backend creation (with `ucx_backend_params`): only UCX can receive `num_threads`, and only when it is the sole backend. Every other backend gets `{}`.

**Flow touched** (worker init only; the transfer path is unchanged):
1. The worker reads `backends`, `num_threads` and `ucx_backend_params` from `kv_connector_extra_config`.
2. It builds `nixl_agent_config`. In normal mode NIXL creates the backends from `config.backends`, passing `num_threads` under each backend's own name.
3. In explicit mode (with `ucx_backend_params`), the agent is created with `backends=[]` and vLLM calls `create_backend(name, params)` for each backend.
4. The backends then use the value, e.g. LIBFABRIC sizes its descriptor post thread pool and UCX its worker threads.

**Why the default is not forwarded.** The default of `4` is tuned for UCX, to avoid exhausting UAR doorbell pages on Mellanox NICs. Forwarding it unconditionally would quietly change thread counts for every non-UCX user, and in mixed `["UCX","LIBFABRIC"]` setups, which get no `num_threads` today. Only an explicitly set value is forwarded.

**Mixed backends.** With `["UCX","LIBFABRIC"]` and `num_threads: N`, both backends get `N`. To set them separately: `NIXL_LIBFABRIC_NUM_THREADS` overrides LIBFABRIC's value inside NIXL, and in explicit mode `ucx_backend_params.num_threads` overrides UCX's value, since it is applied after `num_threads`.

**Tests.** I extended the existing `ucx_backend_params` test with a mixed-backend explicit case, and added a parametrized test that checks the agent config receives `num_threads` (UCX-only default, LIBFABRIC with and without an explicit value, mixed). These use the same `NixlWrapper`/`nixl_agent_config` stubs as the existing backend-params test.

**Not a duplicate.** I searched open and closed issues and PRs for `num_threads`, LIBFABRIC, non-UCX and `nixl_agent_config` under NixlConnector. No PR forwards `num_threads` to non-UCX backends. #59877 and #61638 edit the same `nixl_agent_config(...)` lines to add sync-mode arguments, but they keep the non-UCX branch without `num_threads`. Whichever of these merges first will cause a small textual conflict for the others.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to investigate, implement and write up this change.

files.patch:
@@ -63,6 +63,10 @@ vllm serve <MODEL> \
 !!! note
     Backend availability depends on how NIXL was built and what plugins are present in your environment. Refer to the [NIXL repository](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/nixl) for available backends and build instructions.
 
+#### NIXL backend threads
+
+`kv_connector_extra_config.num_threads` is passed to NIXL, which forwards it to the configured backends that take a thread count, e.g. UCX (worker threads) and LIBFABRIC (descriptor post thread pool). If it is not set, vLLM passes `4` when UCX is the only backend; otherwise it passes nothing, and each backend keeps its NIXL default (for LIBFABRIC, no post thread pool).
+
 #### UCX backend parameters
 
 `kv_connector_extra_config.ucx_backend_params` passes extra init parameters to NIXL's UCX backend. Values are strings. For example, NIXL creates UCX with `ucx_error_handling_mode=peer` by default; UCX then uses only transports that can detect peer failure, which can exclude intra-node GPU transports such as `rocm_ipc`. To trade that error handling for those transports:

@@ -5202,6 +5202,19 @@ def create_backend(self, backend: str, init_params: dict[str, str]) -> None:
             [],
             [("UCX", {"ucx_error_handling_mode": "none"}), ("LIBFABRIC", {})],
         ),
+        # An explicit num_threads reaches every backend.
+        (
+            {
+                "backends": ["UCX", "LIBFABRIC"],
+                "num_threads": 2,
+                "ucx_backend_params": {"ucx_error_handling_mode": "none"},
+            },
+            [],
+            [
+                ("UCX", {"num_threads": "2", "ucx_error_handling_mode": "none"}),
+                ("LIBFABRIC", {"num_threads": "2"}),
+            ],
+        ),
         # UCX not selected: the params have nothing to apply to.
         (
             {
@@ -5240,3 +5253,51 @@ def agent_config(backends=None, num_threads=0, capture_telemetry=False):
     wrapper = connector.connector_worker.nixl_wrapper
     assert wrapper.config.backends == agent_backends
     assert wrapper.created_backends == created_backends
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "extra_config, agent_backends, agent_num_threads",
+    [
+        # UCX alone gets the UCX-tuned default of 4.
+        ({}, ["UCX"], 4),
+        ({"num_threads": 8}, ["UCX"], 8),
+        # Other backends get num_threads only when it is set; otherwise it is
+        # not passed at all (None), leaving NIXL's defaults.
+        ({"backends": ["LIBFABRIC"]}, ["LIBFABRIC"], None),
+        ({"backends": ["LIBFABRIC"], "num_threads": 8}, ["LIBFABRIC"], 8),
+        ({"backends": ["UCX", "LIBFABRIC"]}, ["UCX", "LIBFABRIC"], None),
+        (
+            {"backends": ["UCX", "LIBFABRIC"], "num_threads": 2},
+            ["UCX", "LIBFABRIC"],
+            2,
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_nixl_num_threads(dist_init, extra_config, agent_backends, agent_num_threads):
+    """num_threads reaches the NIXL agent config for UCX and non-UCX backends."""
+
+    def agent_config(backends=None, num_threads=None, capture_telemetry=False):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            backends=["UCX"] if backends is None else backends,
+            num_threads=num_threads,
+        )
+
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(kv_connector_extra_config=extra_config)
+    with (
+        patch(
+            "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.base_worker.NixlWrapper",
+            _BackendRecordingNixlWrapper,
+        ),
+        patch(
+            "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.base_worker.nixl_agent_config",
+            agent_config,
+        ),
+        set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config),
+    ):
+        connector = NixlConnector(
+            vllm_config, KVConnectorRole.WORKER, make_kv_cache_config(block_size=16)
+        )
+    wrapper = connector.connector_worker.nixl_wrapper
+    assert wrapper.config.backends == agent_backends
+    assert wrapper.config.num_threads == agent_num_threads
+    assert wrapper.created_backends == []

@@ -110,6 +110,8 @@
 _INVALID_PEER_MIN_BACKOFF_S = 1.0
 _INVALID_PEER_MAX_BACKOFF_S = 60.0
 _MAX_HYBRID_BLOCK_SPLIT = 128
+# Default NIXL num_threads when UCX is the only backend; see the UAR note at its use.
+_UCX_DEFAULT_NUM_THREADS = 4
 
 
 def _region_sort_key(layer_name: str) -> tuple[tuple[int, int | str], ...]:
@@ -786,14 +788,20 @@ def __init__(
         # initialization with "mlx5dv_devx_alloc_uar" errors.
         # Ref: https://network.nvidia.com/files/doc-2020/ethernet-adapters-programming-manual.pdf#page=63
         num_threads = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.get_from_extra_config(
-            "num_threads", 4
+            "num_threads", None
         )
+        # The default is tuned for UCX, so it applies only to UCX alone.
+        if num_threads is None and not non_ucx_backends:
+            num_threads = _UCX_DEFAULT_NUM_THREADS
         if nixl_agent_config is None:
             config = None
         else:
+            thread_kwargs = {} if num_threads is None else {"num_threads": num_threads}
             # Enable telemetry by default for NIXL 0.7.1 and above.
             config = (
-                nixl_agent_config(backends=self.nixl_backends, capture_telemetry=True)
+                nixl_agent_config(
+                    backends=self.nixl_backends, capture_telemetry=True, **thread_kwargs
+                )
                 if len(non_ucx_backends) > 0
                 else nixl_agent_config(num_threads=num_threads, capture_telemetry=True)
             )
@@ -814,17 +822,19 @@ def __init__(
             self.nixl_wrapper.create_backend(
                 "UCX",
                 {
-                    "num_threads": str(num_threads),
+                    "num_threads": str(
+                        _UCX_DEFAULT_NUM_THREADS if num_threads is None else num_threads
+                    ),
                     "engine_config": "RCACHE_ENABLE=n,TLS=^cuda_ipc",
                     **ucx_backend_params,
                 },
             )
         elif explicit_backends:
             for backend in self.nixl_backends:
                 nixl_params: dict[str, str] = {}
+                if num_threads is not None:
+                    nixl_params["num_threads"] = str(num_threads)
                 if backend == "UCX":
-                    if not non_ucx_backends:
-                        nixl_params["num_threads"] = str(num_threads)
                     nixl_params.update(ucx_backend_params)
                 self.nixl_wrapper.create_backend(backend, nixl_params)
         # Map of engine_id -> {(pp_rank, tp_rank): agent_name, ...}.
